import json,sys,statistics
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from cost_model import CostModel,align
cm=CostModel(64)
for b in (1,2):
    rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open(f'input_data/requests_bucket_{b}.jsonl')]
    reqs={r['request_id']:r for r in rs}
    # individual
    plan=[{'request_id':r['request_id'],'batch_id':r['request_id'],'shape':{'seq_align':align(r['prompt_len'],64),'heads_align':32,'hidden_align':4096}} for r in rs]
    m=cm.plan_metrics(reqs,plan)
    print('B',b,'individual cost %.3e pad %.4f p95 %.3e seq %.3e'%(m['cost'],m['pad_ratio'],m['p95_latency_ms'],m['sequential_timecost']))
    # per request lat individual distribution
    lats=[]
    for r in rs:
        mm=cm.batch_metrics([r]); lats.append(mm['latencies'][0]+8)
    lats.sort()
    print(' individual lat p50 %.3e p90 %.3e p95 %.3e p99 %.3e max %.3e'%(lats[len(lats)//2],lats[int(.9*len(lats))],lats[int(.95*len(lats))],lats[int(.99*len(lats))],lats[-1]))
    # by gen exact groups
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups=defaultdict(list)
    for r in rs: groups[r['gen_len']].append(r)
    plan=[];bid=0
    for g,grs in groups.items():
        bid+=1
        s=max(align(r['prompt_len'],64) for r in grs)
        # shape use s? unique >8 but ignore compile maybe
        for r in grs: plan.append({'request_id':r['request_id'],'batch_id':f'g{g}','shape':{'seq_align':s,'heads_align':32,'hidden_align':4096}})
    m=cm.plan_metrics(reqs,plan)
    print(' per-gen cost %.3e pad %.4f p95 %.3e seq %.3e batches %d'%(m['cost'],m['pad_ratio'],m['p95_latency_ms'],m['sequential_timecost'],len(groups)))
PY

import json, sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/task_file/scripts')
from cost_model import align, HEADS, HIDDEN, CostModel
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/task_file')
for b,tgt in ((1,2.4e8),(2,2.2e7)):
    rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open(root/f'input_data/requests_bucket_{b}.jsonl')]
    shapeS=max(align(r['prompt_len'],64) for r in rs)
    clusters=json.load(open(f'/workspace/clusters_b{b}.json'))
    recs=[]
    for i,c in enumerate(clusters):
        bid=f'b-{i+1:04d}'
        for rid in c['ids']:
            recs.append({'request_id':rid,'batch_id':bid,'shape':{'seq_align':shapeS,'heads_align':HEADS,'hidden_align':HIDDEN}})
    out=root/f'output_data/plan_b{b}.jsonl'
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with open(out,'w') as f:
        for r in recs:
            f.write(json.dumps(r)+'\n')
    # validate from written plan
    plan=[json.loads(x) for x in open(out)]
    reqmap={r['request_id']:r for r in rs}
    ids=[p['request_id'] for p in plan]
    assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==len(rs)
    assert set(ids)==set(reqmap)
    bybatch={}
    for p in plan:
        bybatch.setdefault(p['batch_id'],set()).add((p['shape']['seq_align'],p['shape']['heads_align'],p['shape']['hidden_align']))
        s=p['shape']['seq_align']; r=reqmap[p['request_id']]
        assert s>=align(r['prompt_len'],64)
        assert p['shape']['heads_align']==32 and p['shape']['hidden_align']==4096
    assert all(len(v)==1 for v in bybatch.values())
    shapes={(p['shape']['seq_align'],p['shape']['heads_align'],p['shape']['hidden_align']) for p in plan}
    assert len(shapes)<=8
    m=CostModel(64).plan_metrics(reqmap,plan)
    print('B',b,'records',len(plan),'batches',len(bybatch),'shapes',shapes)
    print('  cost %.6e (thr %s)  pad %.6f (thr %s)  p95 %.6e (thr %s)  seq %.6e (thr %s)'%(
        m['cost'],'3.0e11' if b==1 else '4.8e10',
        m['pad_ratio'],'0.055' if b==1 else '0.15',
        m['p95_latency_ms'],'2.1e6' if b==1 else '2.1e5',
        m['sequential_timecost'],'2.7e8' if b==1 else '3.2e7'))
